summary: Link is Clicked in Saleshandy: note created in HubSpot shows an empty Click Count after the link is clicked
description:
**Prerequisites:**
- Staging account connected to HubSpot.
- Link is Clicked in Saleshandy trigger enabled with the "Create a Task in HubSpot" activity only (Task Title: Follow up from the workflow, Task Type: Call, Task Priority: Medium, Due In: 3 Days).
- Active sequence "HubSpot Link Clicked QA" (Track link clicks on) with 2 links in the step 1 email.
- The prospect's contact exists in HubSpot.

**Steps to Reproduce:**
1. Add the prospect to the sequence and send the step 1 email.
2. Open the email in the prospect's inbox and click the first link (https://www.saleshandy.com/).
3. In Saleshandy, open the sequence > Emails and wait until Clicked shows 1 for the prospect.
4. Open API & Integrations > Integrations > HubSpot > Logs and wait for the new "Link is Clicked in Saleshandy" entry to show Success.
5. Open the contact in HubSpot > Activities and open the note "Note created via Saleshandy".

**Actual Result:**
- The log entry shows Success (3.2 seconds). Execution ID: 6accd19ecab06eccf0e7e088 (Oct 12, 2026, 5:55 PM IST).
- The note is created with Title: email-link-clicked, Sequence, Sequence Name, Step: 1, Variant: A, Sender Email, Prospect Email, User and Link URL: https://www.saleshandy.com/.
- The "Click Count:" line in the note is empty, although the link was clicked and Clicked shows 1 in Saleshandy.
- A screenshot will be attached to the ticket manually.

**Expected Result:**
- The "Click Count:" line in the note shows the number of clicks.

**Note:**
- Seen on HubSpot contact Min-jun Yoon (record 565322291905), sequence 196221.
waitingFor: QA to confirm: (1) this is a bug and the Expected Result (Click Count shows the number of clicks), (2) epic AL-3982 and link AL-4014 (Link is Clicked tracking sub-task), (3) attach a screenshot of the note on HubSpot contact 565322291905 and of Logs entry 6accd19ecab06eccf0e7e088.
